question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.

The increasing population of a country can be a ________ (affliction) for the development of a country.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bane**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Affliction" **essentially means something that causes pain or suffering. It refers to a state of distress, agony, or trouble. (दु:खद समस्या)

 
 
• **Example:** Poverty is a major affliction affecting numerous people around the world.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym **"Bane"** also signifies a cause of trouble, annoyance, or distress. It can denote something that spoils or ruins. (विपत्ति)
 
 
• Example: Corruption has been the **bane** of many developing nations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Bane**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Boom:** This word typically indicates a period of economic prosperity or rapid growth. It does not fit as a synonym for "affliction". (उछाल)
 
• **Boon:** This word usually means a beneficial thing that brings great advantage or benefit. It is the opposite of "affliction". (वरदान)
 
• **Brittleness: **It denotes the quality of being hard but liable to break or shatter easily. It's unrelated to the core concept of "affliction". (भंगुरता)
